headline: Cape Intensifies as Godcrofts and Mooring Rekindle
war_summary: Since the 0610 edition Callum's Cape has intensified to 11 transfers in two hours and 25 on the day about Naofa, Scouts Jest and Ire, now holding at four Warden and three Colonial posts amid 962 Colonial and 1,096 Warden casualties in two hours with both rates accelerating, while Godcrofts has broken out with seven transfers in two hours all at Isawa and 355 Colonial and 616 Warden casualties in the span. Mooring County has rekindled with five transfers in two hours at the Wind Hills and the Cut for 11 Warden and one Colonial post alongside 1,390 Colonial and 1,593 Warden casualties in two hours, and Linn Mercy stays busy with six in two hours and 30 on the day at Outwich Ranch, Rotdust and Lathair for 10 Colonial posts and one ruin. The Weathered Expanse holds at three in two hours and 33 on the day across Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and others for seven Warden posts and two ruins, while the Nevish Line, Marban Hollow and Callahan's Passage have gone quiet with none in two hours, Nevish still counting 45 on the day for eight Colonial posts.
